<!--
  A sidebar section heading with optional right actions. Set `expanded` and it becomes a disclosure button
  (aria-expanded, the toggle event).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import { variants } from "../utils";

/** SectionHead: the classes of each value (shadcn/cva style). */
export const sectionHeadVariants = variants({
  base: "flex items-center justify-between pr-4 pl-4",
  variants: {
    size: {
      default: "h-8 py-2 text-xs font-semibold",
      lg: "h-12 py-2 text-sm font-bold",
    },
  },
  defaultVariants: { size: "default" },
});

export type SectionHeadProps = {
  size?: "default" | "lg";
  expanded?: boolean;
  controls?: string;
  class?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import ButtonPlain from "../primitives/button-plain/button-plain.vue";
import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { size = "default", expanded, controls, class: className } = defineProps<SectionHeadProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ toggle: [] }>();
defineSlots<{ default?(): unknown, right?(): unknown }>();
const cls = computed(() =>
  cn(
    sectionHeadVariants({ size: size }),
    "rounded text-foreground in-data-[nav=collapsed]:hidden",
    className,
  )
);
</script>

<template>
  <ButtonPlain v-if="(expanded != null)"
    type="button"
    :class="cn(cls, 'w-full text-left')"
    :aria-expanded="expanded"
    :aria-controls="controls"
    data-slot="section-head"
    :data-expanded="expanded"
    @click="() => emit('toggle')"
  >
    <Inline data-slot="section-head-title">
      <slot />
    </Inline>
    <Inline v-if="$slots.right" class="flex items-center gap-2" data-slot="section-head-right">
      <slot name="right" />
    </Inline>
  </ButtonPlain>
  <Box v-else :class="cls" data-slot="section-head">
    <Inline data-slot="section-head-title">
      <slot />
    </Inline>
    <Inline v-if="$slots.right" class="flex items-center gap-2" data-slot="section-head-right">
      <slot name="right" />
    </Inline>
  </Box>
</template>
